gallery.filename: Inside of reconstructed Prisoner Barracks, Fort Delaware.jpg
gallery.title: File:Inside of reconstructed Prisoner Barracks, Fort Delaware.jpg
gallery.description: This is the inside of a typical Confederate Prisoner barracks, reconstructed. They were designed to house the Confederate prisoners three-high.  The closeness of the bunks contributed greatly to the many prisoners who died on the island, over 2700.  Most are buried in trenches at Finns Point National Cemetery, New Jersey.
